reviews.title: Love this computer desktop tower
reviews.comment: This is a beautiful case with great dimensions and easy to work in. Cable management was a breeze and the components inside are kept very cool with the recommended fan placement. Good value for a midrange case that looks like a high end model. The led screen works great. Only cons are that I bought the case because of the external LED control but it is founded on an outdated technology and will not work with my modern motherboard or modern ARGB controller. So basically, the case LED/ARGB switch is non-functional. I also could not find a local supplier for matching case fans and AliExpress, only location I found the fans, would not mail them to my location. The company needs to update the case and fans but otherwise I really like this case and will buy it again for my next build.
reviews.author: Jaime Colombani

reviews.title: Pretty good case!
reviews.comment: This was the first case I ever purchased from this brand. Not bad and it looks great with decent airflow. Just make sure that you don't have too much wiring going on or you might have a management issue or 2. Other than that, great case.

reviews.title: Title: Looks slick, but acoustics and layout are a dealbreaker
reviews.comment: Visually, the L280M nails the aesthetic—curved glass, ARGB fans, and a built-in display that should elevate the build. But once you get past the glamor, the flaws stack up fast. Rear mesh design amplifies tonal flutter and fan resonance, especially with a rear-mounted AIO. Even at idle, pump hum is audible and persistent. Fan layout is restrictive—bottom intake only, no front mesh, and rear panel overloaded with 3 exhaust fans. Airflow suffers, and acoustics take a hit. RAM clearance is tight for tower coolers. My 44mm modules forced a fan lift, which nearly maxed out the case’s 157mm cooler clearance. LCD display software is dead—links on darkFlash’s site are broken, and no support available. PCI slot guards are tear-out style, not reusable, which feels dated and cheap. If you’re chasing silence, thermal headroom, or clean cable routing, this case will fight you every step of the way. I ended up swapping it out entirely to restore acoustic integrity and simplify my layout. Bottom line: Great showroom piece, but not built for serious builders or resale polish.
reviews.author: philip c. demondo
